title: Emergent Tonal Structure in Learned Chord Embeddings and Its Relation to Tonal Tension
abstract: arXiv:2609.36460v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Several tonal pitch spaces and computational models have been proposed to analyze tonal structure in Western tonal music, many of them grounded in principles from music theory and used to support tonal analysis with important implications for tonal tension. In parallel, data-driven methods such as skip-gram have been used to learn chord embeddings from symbolic corpora, but their ability to recover tonal structure and its relation to tonal tension remains underexplored. In this work, we investigate how skip-gram chord embeddings reflect tonal structure and whether they provide a useful basis for analyzing structural aspects of tonal tension. Using chord sequences with and without transposition-based augmentation, we evaluate the learned spaces from geometric, functional, and tension-related perspectives. translated_title: 学习得到的和弦嵌入中涌现的调性结构及其与调性张力的关系
translated_abstract: 已有多种调性音高空间与计算模型被提出用于分析西方调性音乐中的调性结构，其中许多基于音乐理论原理，并被用于支持调性分析，对调性张力具有重要意义。与此同时，诸如skip-gram等数据驱动方法已被用于从符号语料库中学习和弦嵌入，但它们恢复调性结构的能力及其与调性张力之间的关系仍未得到充分探索。在本工作中，我们研究了skip-gram和弦嵌入如何反映调性结构，以及它们是否能为分析调性张力的结构方面提供有用的基础。通过使用带移调增强与不带移调增强的和弦序列，我们从几何、功能与张力相关等多个视角评估所学习到的空间。我们表明，经过增强的嵌入表现出强移调等变性，恢复了清晰的五度圈结构，并支持……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 本研究揭示，通过skip-gram学习的和弦嵌入（尤其是经移调增强训练的）能够自发涌现出五度圈等调性结构，从而为分析调性张力提供了有效基础。
en_tdlr: This work shows that skip-gram learned chord embeddings, especially with transposition-based augmentation, emergently recover tonal structures such as the circle of fifths and serve as a useful basis for analyzing tonal tension.
